description: SOC-thermal voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R(T), with Arrhenius resistance and capacity correction

cell.name: Aprotic Li-O2 cell (Li metal / carbon air cathode)
cell.source: Laoire et al. (2010), J. Electrochem. Soc. 157(7), A821; Abraham & Jiang (1996), J. Electrochem. Soc. 143, 1; Viswanathan et al. (2011), J. Chem. Phys. 135, 214704

capacity_ref.note: Practical capacity limited by pore clogging in air cathode

R_ref.note: Internal resistance at T_ref; very high due to Li2O2 insulating film

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Fitted to aprotic Li-O2 OCV profile; theoretical OCV = 2.96 V (vs Li/Li+) for Li2O2 formation

E_a.note: High activation energy; Li-O2 ORR/OER kinetics are strongly thermally activated
E_a.source: Viswanathan et al. (2011), J. Chem. Phys. 135, 214704; Laoire et al. (2010), J. Electrochem. Soc. 157, A821

alpha_c.note: Capacity temperature coefficient; moderate since oxygen solubility increases with T

dOCV_dT.note: Large negative entropic coefficient for Li-air; dOCV/dT ~ -0.50 mV/K. The O2 reduction Li + O2 + e- -> LiO2 -> Li2O2 reaction involves gas phase, giving large negative entropy (negative dOCV/dT). This is the most negative of all common battery chemistries.
dOCV_dT.source: Viswanathan et al. (2011), J. Chem. Phys. 135, 214704; Lu et al. (2013), Nat. Chem. 5, 527

current.note: Negative=charge, Positive=discharge; Li-air limited to very low rates
